page.layout: One page of text, single column, with the page number at the top left. Below the text, an "INDEX" heading set in spaced capitals, right of centre.

p.i: Non accidet tibi malum; neque plaga appropin-quabit tabernaculo tuo.
Quoniam angelis suis mandabit de te, ut custo-diant te in omnibus viis tuis.
In manibus portabunt te, ne forte impingat ad lapidem pes tuus.
Super Leonem & Basiliscum calcabis, conculcabis catulum Leonis & draconem.
Quoniam me valde amat, propterea eruam: exaltabo eum, quoniam agnoscit nomen meum.
Invocabit me & exaudiam eum, cum ipso ero in angustia, eruam & glorificabo eum.
Longitudine dierum saturabo eum, & videre faciam eum salutem meam.

page.notes: Printed line-end hyphens kept in "appropin-quabit" and "custo-diant". The printed "vijs" is read as the vowel i, so "viis". Long s is transcribed as s throughout, and the text is set in italic type. No marginal notes, catchword, running head or signature are printed. The "INDEX" heading is the title of an index that follows on the next page.
